title: eugenia daenikeri
intro: Eugenia daenikeri, commonly known as the Ceylon olive or Indian plum, is a plant species belonging to the family Myrtaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of fever and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia daenikeri are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, the plant has been studied for its potential to modulate the immune system and exhibit cytotoxic effects against certain cancer cells.
